coupled_thermal_ideal_gas.meaning_zh: 宿主step推进有限功率集中热节点与绝压理想气体模型；命令可依据预测温压拒绝危险设定。
equations: C dT/dt=P-UA(T-Ta), exact piecewise exponential with target holding and no instantaneous cooling.
P_abs=nRT/V, n fixed while lid and vent closed.
dn/dt=(Pamb*V/(R*T(t))-n)/15s; integrating factor quadrature along exact T(t).
20700000 Pa gauge + 101325 Pa reference atmosphere = 20801325 Pa absolute；状态和气体状态方程使用绝压。
Q_heater-Q_environment=C*(T-T_initial)；所有有效热容和散热代理与厂家真实物性分开。

maximum_gauge_pressure_pa.meaning_zh: PARR_4590_SPEC; PARR_399M_MANUAL p7 pressure is psig; standard configuration, CE/UKCA 200 bar not selected.

maximum_temperature_k.meaning_zh: PARR_4590_SPEC; standard FKM seal 225 deg C

thermal_capacity_j_k.meaning_zh: Effective-node assumption selected for initial 700/1000 = 0.7 K/s. Order of magnitude considers documented 1.587573295 kg cylinder with assumed steel cp near500 J/kg/K; neither alloy cp nor assembly effective thermal capacity is measured.

heat_loss_w_k.meaning_zh: Assume 20% of700W lost at200K excess: UA=140/200=.7W/K; power does not uniquely identify C or UA.

open_extra_loss_w_k.meaning_zh: Illustrative additional passive loss while open.

vent_time_constant_s.meaning_zh: Illustrative exponential absolute-pressure relaxation to ambient; no valve calibration.

opening_temperature_k.meaning_zh: Simulation-only50degC opening threshold; not a factory interlock or hardware safety advice.

lid_travel_m.meaning_zh: Detached-head illustrative opening pose, not measured travel; required vessel removal from stand is not modeled as a robot operation.

maximum_speed_rad_s.meaning_zh: PARR_399M_MANUAL pp20-21 standard1700rpm pulley; continuous0..1700 control range is an assumption.

ambient_pressure_pa.meaning_zh: Standard atmosphere used to convert gauge pressure to absolute pressure.

manufacturer_heatup_time_s.meaning_zh: No loaded4591 heatup curve or factory time benchmark validated.

limitations: full只表示该标准FKM配置的功能组件完整登记；不代表所有厂家操作、机器人或硬件功能已实现。
4591 moveable-head25mL、FKM225°C、700W；不混用HP、HT、FFKM或其他容积规格。207bar为表压；CE/UKCA200bar版本不是本配置。
釜架基本型尺寸与55lb/18lb/3.5lb是厂家估计；附加控制器质量和实际部件质量、质心、摩擦与惯量未知。URDF近似政策见geometry_manifest。
开盖动作保存前移提釜并提升釜盖的示意终态；未验证移取路径、皮带脱开、机械联轴、密封接触、受力或机器人操作。
原生Blender由实际宿主回调同步；GLB与OBJ保存导出姿态，不能视为独立过程驱动。
本次几何为4591反应釜/釜架基本型；外接控制器没有独立几何。温度读数与设置由API提供，不声明已经建立温度数显屏。
量化温压读数是estimated代理；不能宣称厂家传感器精度、实际实验安全或真实样品反应结果。
单热节点与理想气体不求解蒸气压、反应热、产气、搅拌流场或安全泄放设计；超压拒绝只是仿真语义。
读状态不推进时间；共同宿主step推进所有实例；request_id去重仅保存在当前宿主内存。
API可见性过滤不构成Python进程或共享文件系统隔离；受限真值与debug证据需宿主控制访问。
机器人、真实硬件、接触动力学和真实化学效果验证均not_run。
25mL is modeled entirely as constant ideal-gas volume; no sample loading, liquid expansion, boiling, dissolved gas, reactions, rupture-disc failure or high-pressure real-gas accuracy.
P_abs=nRT/V;207bar limit is gauge pressure, absolute limit20801325Pa uses assumed101325Pa ambient. No CE/UKCA200bar configuration.
C=1000J/K and UA=.7W/K are explicit effective-node assumptions constrained in scale by700W, not uniquely inferred or manufacturer-calibrated; factory dynamic comparison not_run.
Temperature rounds0.1degC and pressure rounds100Pa, quality=estimated; no measured sensor accuracy.

Opening temperature and pressure conditions are simulation rules, not validated hardware interlocks. Moveable head assumes drive detached and vessel removed; full robot/mechanical opening sequence absent.
Only1700rpm standard pulley endpoint is documented; continuous control, instantaneous speed changes and zero-speed stop are modeled assumptions; no drag/torque/mixing.
Vent15s relaxation is uncalibrated and gas exchange energy is omitted from the effective solid thermal node; no adiabatic blowdown or real vent sizing.
API filtering is not a Python process or filesystem sandbox. Host state and debug records must remain trusted. No persistent deduplication after restart.

Non-isothermal vent model integrates dn/dt=(Pamb*V/(R*T(t))-n)/15s along the exact thermal trajectory. Adaptive Simpson absolute tolerance1e-14 K^-1; exponential tail beyond40 time constants omitted (<exp(-40)/273.15 K^-1). Failure to converge rejects the entire host step before commit.

coverage.note_zh: 热核心、密闭气体压力、搅拌角一致（温度差 ≤0.0003 K，压力差 ≤5.7 Pa）；反应化学未搬；关节化 USD（1 个旋钮（可转动）、8 个门/盖/阀等被动关节）；接口点 1 个（孔位）；布局：台面、单人可搬、正面 −y、前方留空 0.25 m；面板读数 heat(灯)
